A simple 7-day view for your routine shows **6 active days**, **1 rest day**, and a balanced mix of cardio, mobility, and strength. Mild seasonal allergies can make outdoor sessions feel harder on some days, so it helps to watch for pattern changes in pace, recovery, and breathing comfort.

- **Consistency:** You moved every day except Wednesday, which supports routine adherence.
